question: Please list the time of the races held on Sepang International Circuit.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "races_with_circuits" AS SELECT c.circuitid AS circuitid, c.circuitref AS circuitref, c.name AS circuit_name, r.year AS race_year, r.round AS race_round, r.name AS race_name, r.date AS race_date, r.time AS race_time FROM table_2 AS r LEFT JOIN table_1 AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH sepang AS (
  SELECT circuit_name, race_year, race_date, race_time, circuitref
  FROM races_with_circuits
  WHERE lower(circuitref) = 'sepang' OR lower(circuit_name) = 'sepang international circuit'
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT circuit_name, race_year, COALESCE(race_time, 'unknown') AS race_time
  FROM sepang
  ORDER BY race_year
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(MAX(circuit_name), 'Sepang International Circuit') AS circuit,
  string_agg(CAST(race_year AS VARCHAR) || ': ' || race_time, ', ') AS race_times
FROM ordered;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT DISTINCT
  race_year AS year,
  race_date AS date,
  COALESCE(race_time, 'unknown') AS local_start_time
FROM races_with_circuits
WHERE lower(circuitref) = 'sepang' OR lower(circuit_name) LIKE '%sepang%'
ORDER BY year;
